description: Move a deal to another stage (or another pipeline), and/or set its status: won, lost (with lost_reason), abandoned, or open again. The move is recorded in the deal's history.

lost_reason.description: Why it was lost, when status is lost.

pipeline.description: Only to move it to a different pipeline.

stage.description: Stage name or id. New deals default to the first stage.

name: crm_move_opportunity
title: Move a deal, or mark it won or lost
